page_title: PAL 1-0 ATM | Las Palmas v Atletico Madrid 19/04/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' Victor Garcia is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+7' Jose Maria Gimenez (Atl. Madrid) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Victor Garcia no option but to blow his whistle.
90+5' Here comes the VAR decision. The goal is given and Las Palmas players have a reason to celebrate!
90+4' The Las Palmas players joy may have been justified, because referee Victor Garcia is going use VAR to determine whether it was offside.
90+4' The referee gives a yellow card to Jaime Mata (Las Palmas) for talking back. He must be careful for the remainder of the match.
90+3' The assistant referee raises his flag and the referee blows his whistle. Javier Munoz (Las Palmas) puts the ball into the net, but he is flagged for offside.
90+3' Shots on target – 1:2.
90' We will have 5 min. of added time.
88' Alex Suarez (Las Palmas) is able to continue to play.
87' The game is interrupted now, Alex Suarez (Las Palmas) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
85' Victor Garcia blows the whistle, Jaime Mata (Las Palmas) is penalised for a foul.
83' Fabio Silva is not able to continue due to his injury and will be replaced by Jaime Mata (Las Palmas).
83' The manager makes a subsitution with Jose Campana (Las Palmas) coming on for Alberto Moleiro.
83' Giuliano Simeone (Atl. Madrid) makes space inside the box for a shot, but his effort goes just wide of the right post.
81' Fabio Silva (Las Palmas) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
79' Diego Martinez has decided to make a change. Sandro Ramirez (Las Palmas) replaces Dario Essugo.
77' Victor Garcia shows a yellow card to Dario Essugo (Las Palmas) for his blatant foul.
75' Substitution. Alexander Sorloth will be replaced by Angel Correa (Atl. Madrid).
75' Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid) connects with a cross from the side, but produces a header which goes way over the bar.
73' Alberto Moleiro (Las Palmas) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will send the ball into the penalty box.

73' Marvin (Las Palmas) received a pass inside the box and sent a dangerous shot in on goal, but keep the champagne on ice as one of the defenders stepped in and blocked the effort. It's hard to say whether the keeper would have stopped it.
71' Javier Munoz (Las Palmas) criticises the decision of the referee and immediately receives a yellow card.
68' Victor Garcia blows his whistle for a foul after Stefan Bajcetic (Las Palmas) hacks down one of his opponents.
68' The current number of shots on goal is 1:2.
67' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Marvin (Las Palmas) is coming onto the pitch as Oliver McBurnie cannot continue after picking up an injury.
65' What a wasted chance that is! An inch-perfect cross into the box finds Alexander Sorloth (Atl. Madrid) who sends his header well wide of the left post.
65' Diego Simeone has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid) replacing Julian Alvarez.
65' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Javi Galan walks off the pitch to be replaced by Cesar Azpilicueta (Atl. Madrid).
62' Stefan Bajcetic (Las Palmas) swings the ball into the box from the corner kick but it's a bit too strong and it goes out of play.
59' Diego Simeone decides to make a substitution. Conor Gallagher will be replaced by Rodrigo Riquelme (Atl. Madrid).
59' The substitution has been made. Rodrigo de Paul (Atl. Madrid) has replaced Koke.
56' Viti (Las Palmas) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Jan Oblak, who smothers the ball.
54' Javi Galan (Atl. Madrid) is cautioned by the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
53' Some neat passing and movement from Atl. Madrid as they ping around some short passes in order to create a new attacking opportunity.
50' The attendance is 27154.
49' The linesman raises his flag. Alexander Sorloth (Atl. Madrid) is adjudged offside.
46' Referee Victor Garcia blows his whistle to start the second half.
45+1' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
43' 4:3 – the total goal attempt statistics.
41' A corner kick by Atl. Madrid is thwarted by the well prepared Dinko Horkas (Las Palmas).
41' A brilliant cross into the box finds Alexander Sorloth (Atl. Madrid), who directs his header towards the left post, but the goalkeeper shows all his agility and makes an astonishing save.
40' Rough tackle by Conor Gallagher (Atl. Madrid). The referee blows his whistle for a foul.
37' Atl. Madrid have been awarded a corner kick.

37' Julian Alvarez (Atl. Madrid) runs onto a loose pass inside the box and releases a tremendous shot towards the left side of the goal. However, Dinko Horkas anticipates the shot and makes a brilliant save.
34' The ball goes out of play. Atl. Madrid are awarded a corner kick.
33' Javi Galan (Atl. Madrid) brings his opponent down. Victor Garcia has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle for a foul.
32' We can have a look at the statistics now, particularly the total attempts – 4:1.
29' Dario Essugo (Las Palmas) makes a good run with the ball, but his shot from the edge of the penalty area goes just wide of the right post. Terrific solo effort, though.
27' Mika Marmol (Las Palmas) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort.
24' Javier Munoz (Las Palmas) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Victor Garcia blows his whistle for a foul.
22' A header by Alex Suarez (Las Palmas) from very close range goes towards the middle of the target, but doesn't get past Jan Oblak, who makes a nice save.
22' Javier Munoz (Las Palmas) quickly takes the corner kick with a short pass.
20' Atl. Madrid quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
18' Mika Marmol (Las Palmas) makes a slide tackle, but referee Victor Garcia blows for a foul.
17' Conor Gallagher (Atl. Madrid) tackles a bit over-zealously and Victor Garcia blows for a foul.
16' Javier Munoz (Las Palmas) sends in the corner, but fails to find the head of any of his teammates, allowing the defence to clear.
15' Viti (Las Palmas) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
12' Pablo Barrios (Atl. Madrid) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Victor Garcia saw the whole situation.
9' The defender bravely blocks the shot from Conor Gallagher (Atl. Madrid) inside the box.
8' Oliver McBurnie (Las Palmas) makes a strong challenge and Victor Garcia blows for a foul.
7' Atl. Madrid players are exchanging short passes with one another, waiting for the right moment to beat the opposition's defence.
3' Fabio Silva (Las Palmas) holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.

The players are out at last! Atl. Madrid will take the kick-off.
